Def_Act_Vested::OJ2.formula: IF(OI2="NULL","N",IF( OR(AND(NOT(F2="DOR"),$H2="V"),ISBLANK(FS2),FS2="NULL"), "NULL", IF( IF( FB2<DOPT, ABS(OI2)<=MAX(5,0.05*MIN(OG2,OH2)), ABS(OI2)<=1 ), "N", IF(OI2=0,"M",IF(OI2>0,"I",IF(OI2<=IF(DOTR>=DATE(2014,10,1),-1,-5),"D","N"))) ) ))

Def_Act_Vested::OR2.formula: IF( AND(EI2>0,Z2="PLAN",HJ2<>"N"), "N", IF(AND(F2="DOR", AL2="PLAN", HW2="Y", OR(OW2="M",OW2="N"), MY2=0),"N", IF(PD2="Y","N","Y")) )

Def_Act_Vested::PI2.formula: IF(PF2="NULL","NULL",IF(PF2="2","Straight Life Annuity",IF(PF2="5",ROUND(PH2/12,0)&"-year Certain-and-Continuous Annuity",IF(PF2="4",ROUND(PH2/12,0)&"-year Certain Annuity",IF(PF2="9","Joint-and-"&ROUND(PG2*100,2)&"% Survivor Annuity","Joint-and-"&ROUND(HG2*100,2)&"% Survivor 'Pop-up' Annuity")))))

Retirees::CY2.formula: IF( BX2="N", "NULL", IF( AI2<>"NULL", ROUND( COMPAYM(AI2,AM2),4), "NULL" ) )

Retirees::HP2.formula: IF(HM2="NULL","NULL",IF(HM2="2","Straight Life Annuity",IF(HM2="5",ROUND(HO2/12,0)&"-year Certain-and-Continuous Annuity",IF(HM2="4",ROUND(HO2/12,0)&"-year Certain Annuity",IF(HM2="9","Joint-and-"&ROUND(HN2*100,2)&"% Survivor Annuity","Joint-and-"&ROUND(HN2*100,2)&"% Survivor 'Pop-up' Annuity")))))
